# These pins encode the render's CURRENT behavior, remaining defects included.
# They are a diff surface for Lane R, not a statement of desired output.
# No known-defective behavior remains as of P1P-T6.
# Repaired in P1P-T5 and pinned here as the corrected behavior:
#   P4-F4  a section shorter than the template's cycle renders the truncated
#          head of that cycle ('one_bar'), where it used to render nothing
#   P4-F5  narrative templates play every step they declare ('phrase', 'arc'),
#          so FADE_IN / FADE_OUT dimmer curves reach the output
#   P4-M1  the template's declared dimmer floor (60) bounds the emitted curve
#   P4-M2  BLACKOUT emits DMX 0 under every preset ('drop')
#   P4-F9  emitted pan/tilt stay inside the rig's calibrated window
#   transitions carry their blended value curves instead of an all-zero string
# Repaired in P1P-T6 and pinned here as the corrected behavior:
#   P4-F3  a channel the fixture maps but nothing wrote gets its declared
#          default (shutter_default=255, color/gobo map's 'open' entry), not a
#          zero-fill; a channel the fixture does not map is omitted entirely;
#          the emitted window is `get_max_channel`, not a floor-16 guess
#   P4-F10 value-curve points are written at 4-decimal resolution
